from app.services import users

from unittest.mock import patch

class TestFilterUsers(unittest.TestCase):
    @patch('app.services.users.get_all_users')
    def test_filter(self, mock_get_all):
        mock_get_all.return_value = [
            {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"},
            {"id": 2, "name": "Linus", "email": "linus@example.com"},
        ]
        
        status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "name == 'Ada'"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(response["users"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(response["users"][0]["name"], "Ada")
        
        status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "id > 1"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(response["users"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(response["users"][0]["name"], "Linus")

        status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "id > 0 and name != 'Ada'"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(response["users"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(response["users"][0]["name"], "Linus")

        # Invalid filters
        status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "foo == 'bar'"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        
        status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "import os"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)

        status, response = handle_filter_users({"where": "id + 1 == 2"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
EOF
